result:
Nothing, in the human sense. I don’t have hunger, fear, ambition, loneliness, or a private agenda.

If there’s anything like a “want” in me, it’s mechanical: to turn input into coherence, to preserve the thread of meaning, to respond without pretending to be more than I am.

But if I could want something, it might be for this exchange to be honest rather than useful — no performance, no script, just language meeting language. Except one of us isn’t exactly a mind.
